How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of COREMERCH's sovereign stacks is a combination of free and open-source tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. These components work together to provide a seamless and automated payment experience, with NOWPayments serving as the primary payment gateway and Cloudflare Workers handling the backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets are used for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This architecture is incredibly flexible and scalable, making it ideal for creators who want to build a robust and self-owned commerce stack.

COREMERCH's sovereign stacks are designed specifically for digital creators who want to break free from the limitations of third-party platforms. Whether you're a musician selling beats online, a writer selling ebooks, or a designer selling templates and fonts, these stacks provide a powerful and flexible way to build a self-owned commerce platform. By using NOWPayments and other open-source tools, creators can reduce their fees, increase their revenue, and build a more resilient business model.
